question: Should CodexBar ship both provider-branded default confetti and a persistent palette editor on every provider settings page, or narrow this PR to branded defaults only?
rationale: Provider-specific defaults solve the stated identification problem, while the editor adds permanent UI, persistence, localization, and support surface that cannot be accepted as a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Narrow to branded defaults
options.body: Keep curated provider palettes and celebration wiring, but remove the persisted editor and revisit customization separately if user demand appears.

options.title: Ship full customization
options.body: Accept the provider editor and stored overrides as a supported permanent settings feature after complete bundle-level proof is added.

options.title: Keep randomized celebrations
options.body: Decline both additions and preserve the current generic randomized confetti behavior.

recommendation.title: Narrow to branded defaults
recommendation.body: Keep curated provider palettes and celebration wiring, but remove the persisted editor and revisit customization separately if user demand appears.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the person directly routed into the PR discussion, steipete is the clearest owner for this permanent product-surface decision.
